# COMPRIME TABLA PRINCIPAL (COMPRESS=YES no tiene equivalente en SQL Server: es una opción de almacenamiento SAS sin efecto funcional aquí)
# CIERRE 2021: AJUSTES DE CONTRAGENTE EN EMPRESAS Y HOLDINGS
with engine.begin() as conn:
    res = conn.execute(
        text(
            "UPDATE TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI SET C_CAGENTE = :nuevo_cagente, PROC = :nuevo_proc "
            "WHERE SECTOR IN (51021, 5101, 37) AND C_SCN = :c_scn AND (C_CAGENTE IS NULL OR C_CAGENTE IN ('', :cagente_old))"
        ),
        {"nuevo_cagente": "53", "nuevo_proc": "0600a", "c_scn": "AF.7", "cagente_old": "71"},
    )
    _log("UPDATE TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI ajuste contragente", res.rowcount)
# IMPUTA ACTIVO DE CRÉDITOS COMERCIALES EN SECTOR HOGARES CON CA 51, USANDO INFO DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 51 CON CA 511 (NEGATIVO DE ESTO)
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_511"))
sql_af7_511 = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        511 AS SECTOR,
        '51' AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(T1.DATO * -1) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0602' AS PROC
INTO #af7_511
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_SECTORIZACION T2 ON T1.SECTOR = T2.C_SI
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS T3 ON T1.C_CAGENTE = T3.C_CAGENTE
WHERE T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1 = 'S.11' AND T3.C_SI_SCN_N0 = 'S.14'
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM, T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN, T1.C_ENTRADA
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_511))
# ELIMINA PASIVO DE CREDITOS COMERCIALES EN SECTOR 51 CON CA 511 (USA CONSULTA ANTERIOR)
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_51"))
sql_af7_51 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        51 AS SECTOR,
        '511' AS C_CAGENTE,

        T1.FUENTE,

FROM #af7_511 T1
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_51))

sql_af7_51_53 = """

# APPEND server-side de las 3 tablas anteriores a TABLAS.BD_CTSI (PROC APPEND FORCE)

# IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN ACTIVO DEL SECTOR 352 CON CA 6, USANDO INFO DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 6 CON CA 352
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_352_6"))
sql_af7_352_6 = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) AS SECTOR,
        LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(11))) AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0614' AS PROC
INTO #af7_352_6
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
WHERE T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T1.C_CAGENTE = '352' AND T1.SECTOR = 6
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM, T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN, T1.C_ENTRADA, T1.C_CAGENTE, T1.SECTOR
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_352_6))
# IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN PASIVO DE SECTOR 352 CON CA 511 USANDO 55% DEL PASIVO DE SECTOR 6 CON CA 352
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_352_511"))
sql_af7_352_511 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        T1.SECTOR,
        '511' AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        'H' AS C_ENTRADA,
        (T1.DATO * 0.55) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,

FROM #af7_352_6 t1
"""

# CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DEL RESTO DEL MUNDO CON CA BCO CENTRAL Y GOBIERNO EN EL ACTIVO DE LOS SECTORES.
# REALIZA CONTRA AJUSTE EN CA 53, EXCEPTO EN BCENTRAL QUE AJUSTA EN AF.71 CA RM
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_rm_p"))
sql_af7_rm_p = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        (CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 6 THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END) AS SECTOR,
        '6' AS C_CAGENTE,
        t1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' THEN T1.DATO * -1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0618' AS PROC
INTO #af7_rm_p
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
WHERE (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR IN (31, 41) AND T1.C_CAGENTE = '6')
   OR (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR = 6 AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('31', '41'))
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM,
         (CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 6 THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END),
         T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_rm_p))
# AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 EN GOBIERNO Y EN AF71 CA RM EN BCENTRAL
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_53_6"))
sql_af7_53_6 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        t1.SECTOR,
        (CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 31 THEN '6' ELSE '53' END) AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        T1.C_ENTRADA,
        T1.DATO * -1 AS DATO,
        (CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 31 THEN 'AF.71' ELSE T1.C_SCN END) AS C_SCN,
        (CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 31 THEN 'Ajuste conciliación' ELSE T1.N_SCN END) AS N_SCN,
        T1.FUENTE,
        '0618b' AS PROC
INTO #af7_53_6
FROM #af7_rm_p t1
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_53_6))

for tmp in ["#af7_rm_p", "#af7_53_6"]:
    sql_append = f"INSERT INTO TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI ({cols_bd_ctsi_1}) SELECT {cols_bd_ctsi_1} FROM {tmp}"
    res = work_conn.execute(text(sql_append))
    _log(f"APPEND TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI desde {tmp}", res.rowcount)
for tmp in ["#af7_rm_p", "#af7_53_6"]:
    work_conn.execute(text(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {tmp}"))
# CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES EN ACTIVO DE LOS BANCOS, EXCEPTO CRUCE BANCOS CON BANCOS, CA 41 Y 53.
# REALIZA CONTRA AJUSTE EN CA 53
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_bcos_a"))
sql_af7_bcos_a = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('3') THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int)
              WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE = '3' THEN 32
              ELSE T1.SECTOR END) AS SECTOR,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
        t1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' THEN T1.DATO * -1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0619' AS PROC
INTO #af7_bcos_a
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
WHERE (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR IN (321, 322, 32) AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('321', '322', '32', '41', '53', '9'))
   OR (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR NOT IN (321, 41) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('321', '322', '32', '3'))
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM,
         (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('3') THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int)
              WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE = '3' THEN 32
              ELSE T1.SECTOR END),
         (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END),
         t1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_bcos_a))
# AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR BANCOS
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_321_53"))
sql_af7_321_53 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        t1.SECTOR,
        '53' AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        T1.C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(T1.DATO) * -1 AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        T1.FUENTE,
        '0619b' AS PROC
INTO #af7_321_53
FROM #af7_bcos_a T1
GROUP BY T1.MONEDA, t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, T1.C_SCN, T1.N_SCN, T1.FUENTE
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_321_53))

for tmp in ["#af7_bcos_a", "#af7_321_53"]:
    sql_append = f"INSERT INTO TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI ({cols_bd_ctsi_1}) SELECT {cols_bd_ctsi_1} FROM {tmp}"
    res = work_conn.execute(text(sql_append))
    _log(f"APPEND TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI desde {tmp}", res.rowcount)
for tmp in ["#af7_bcos_a", "#af7_321_53"]:
    work_conn.execute(text(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {tmp}"))
# CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES AUXILIARES Y OFIS EN ACTIVO DE LOS AUXILIARES FINANCIEROS.
# REALIZA CONTRA AJUSTE EN CA 53
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_aux_a"))
sql_af7_aux_a = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END) AS SECTOR,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
        t1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' THEN T1.DATO * -1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0620' AS PROC
INTO #af7_aux_a
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
WHERE (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))), 1, 2) = '36' AND SUBSTRING(T1.C_CAGENTE, 1, 2) IN ('36', '33', '37'))
   OR (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))), 1, 2) IN ('36', '33', '37') AND SUBSTRING(T1.C_CAGENTE, 1, 2) IN ('36', '37'))
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM,
         (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END),
         (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END),
         t1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af7_aux_a))
# AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR AUXILIARES
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_36_53"))
sql_af7_36_53 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],

"""

# CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES AUXILIARES, OFIS Y SEGUROS EN ACTIVO DE LOS SEGUROS.
# REALIZA CONTRA AJUSTE EN CA 53
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_seg_a"))
sql_af7_seg_a = """
SELECT  'P' AS MONEDA,
        t1.[AÑO],
        T1.TRIM,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END) AS SECTOR,
        (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
        t1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,

        T1.C_SCN,

WHERE (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))), 1, 2) = '35' AND SUBSTRING(T1.C_CAGENTE, 1, 2) IN ('36', '33', '37', '35'))
   OR (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.7' AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(CAST(T1.SECTOR AS varchar(7))), 1, 2) IN ('36', '33', '37', '35') AND SUBSTRING(T1.C_CAGENTE, 1, 2) = '35' AND T1.C_CAGENTE <> '351_34')
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], T1.TRIM,
         (CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' THEN TRY_CAST(T1.C_CAGENTE AS int) ELSE T1.SECTOR END),

work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af7_35_53"))
sql_af7_35_53 = """

        t1.[AÑO],

traceability.sas_construct: PROC SQL: UPDATE + serie de CREATE TABLE con agregaciones/CASE + PROC DATASETS APPEND FORCE (~30 imputaciones encadenadas) sobre TABLAS.BD_CTSI
traceability.business_rule: Concilia y cierra créditos comerciales (AF.7/AF.71/AF.9) entre pares de sectores (hogares, bancos, auxiliares, seguros, gobierno, resto del mundo), imputando activo/pasivo faltante con contrapartida en CA 53/6 y repartiendo 55%/45% entre hogares y empresas, dejando el saldo neto de cuenta financiera y errores/omisiones

warnings: Todos los datasets WORK del nodo nacen de TABLAS.BD_CTSI o de otros WORK intermedios de la BD: se materializan como #tmp por work_conn (temp_table_strategy=session_sql), server-side, sin pasar por pandas.

El UPDATE inicial traduce WHERE C_CAGENTE IN ('','71') como (C_CAGENTE IS NULL OR C_CAGENTE IN ('', :cagente_old)) porque tras eventuales joins/actualizaciones previas un '' de SAS puede corresponder a NULL en SQL Server; los valores literales '53'/'0600a'/'AF.7'/'71' van como bind params, no interpolados.
T1.'AÑO'n (nombre de columna con espacio/tilde en SAS) se traduce como identificador entre corchetes [AÑO], asumiendo que ese es el nombre real de la columna en SQL Server.

PUT(x, CHAR n.) / LEFT() se tradujeron como CAST(... AS varchar(n)) + LTRIM(); INPUT(x, BEST.) como TRY_CAST(... AS int); son aproximaciones funcionales, no hay type-cast bit-a-bit garantizado si vienen strings con formato numérico especial de SAS.
CONTAINS de SAS se tradujo como LIKE '%...%' (T-SQL no tiene operador CONTAINS de texto libre equivalente sin full-text search).

Las fórmulas 0.55/0.45 (reparto hogares/empresas) y el multiplicador T2.Porcentaje de T_AJUSTE_CONCILIACION se preservan literales, tal como señala la nota del analista: no están versionadas y su cambio requiere intervención manual, no decisión del traductor.
Todos los INSERT a TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI son acumulativos (append), igual que el PROC DATASETS APPEND FORCE original: re-ejecutar el nodo duplica filas, igual que en SAS.

Las columnas explícitas del INSERT (cols_bd_ctsi_1) asumen que TABLAS.BD_CTSI tiene exactamente esas 12 columnas en ese orden de nombres; si la tabla real tiene columnas adicionales de auditoría, el FORCE de SAS las habría dejado NULL y aquí quedarían fuera del INSERT (mismo comportamiento).

DATA AF7_PASIVO; SET AF7_PASIVO AF7_ACTIVO; se tradujo como INSERT INTO #af7_pasivo SELECT ... FROM #af7_activo (concatenación server-side dentro de la misma #tmp) en vez de crear una tabla nueva, porque SAS reutiliza el mismo nombre de dataset como destino.

El DATA step inicial 'DATA tablas.BD_CTSI (COMPRESS=YES); SET tablas.BD_CTSI; RUN;' no tiene efecto funcional traducible (opción de almacenamiento SAS): se documenta en comentario y no genera código ejecutable.
